vuln_statements.explanation: This statement initiates the handling of user-controlled userdata length (ulen). The vulnerability exists because ulen is not properly validated against the allocated buffer size before being used in subsequent nla_memcpy operations at line 7459. Without proper bounds checking here, an attacker can craft malicious input with oversized ulen values, leading to buffer overflow when copying userdata into the set element structure.

This validation check is intended to validate ulen but may be insufficient. If nft_set_ext_check doesn't properly compare ulen against the actual allocated buffer capacity, the subsequent nla_memcpy operation will proceed with unchecked length values, allowing out-of-bounds memory writes and potential privilege escalation through heap corruption.
